body: Run the segmented-manifest migration ceremony (shipped by T-MANIFEST-FOREST) against this repository's tracked .adlc/manifest.jsonl, in a dedicated PR containing only the migration output — mirroring the sharded ticket-store migration (PR #321, commit d344a35). Preconditions: the toolkit release containing the forest-aware readers and the `gate-manifest migrate` ceremony is installed; ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY is available in the environment (the ceremony verifies existing signatures before freezing the root; it does not refuse for standing approvals — per spec §4.6/§8 it seals every standing root approve with a signed needs-attention entry immediately before the cutover entry, deliberately forcing fresh re-approval under the forest's trust semantics rather than grandfathering old ones in). Steps: (1) run `adlc gate-manifest migrate` (dry-run) and review the plan; (2) run with `--write`; the ceremony freezes .adlc/manifest.jsonl as the root segment WITHOUT rewriting any byte of it, creates .adlc/manifest.d/, and records the cutover evidence entry; (3) open the migration PR; (4) after merge, rebase in-flight PRs and re-record any stale revision-bound attestations (they are stale after rebase by design). Acceptance criteria and verification methods: (a) `adlc gate-manifest verify` exits 0 on the migrated repo with ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY set — run it; (b) the root file is byte-identical before/after migration except for the appended cutover entry permitted by the spec — verify with `git diff` showing only the appended line(s), and sha256 prefix comparison; (c) the rails-guard CI gate passes on the migration PR — observe the required check green; (d) a post-migration `adlc gate-manifest record smoke-test` writes to a segment file under .adlc/manifest.d/ and leaves the root untouched — run it and `git status`/diff to confirm; (e) the cross-model gate finds an attestation recorded post-migration — record one on a test branch and confirm `adlc prosecute` tier-check accepts it. Rollback: the ceremony writes a hash-named backup of the original manifest; restoring it and deleting .adlc/manifest.d/ reverts the repo.
title: Migrate this repository's manifest.jsonl to the segmented (chain forest) format
